Risedle is a decentralized finance protocol that issues leveraged tokens. Risedle operates on public blockchains through smart contracts without intermediaries.

Overlay Protocol is a decentralized finance protocol for perpetual futures trading. Overlay Protocol operates through smart contracts on public blockchains without intermediaries.

TownCrier is an oracle system that delivers authenticated web data to smart contracts. TownCrier was presented as a research system rather than a standalone financial service.

Lyra is a decentralized finance protocol for options trading. Lyra operates through smart contracts on public blockchains without intermediaries.
